h1: APR Calculator for Adjustable Rate Mortgages
subtitle: Work out the composite APR of an adjustable-rate mortgage: the start rate for the fixed period, then the index plus margin as far as the caps allow, with points and fees included. Test your own index path alongside the disclosure figure.

Regulation Z has lenders work out an ARM's APR from the start rate for as long as it lasts, then from the index value at closing plus the margin, limited by the caps (comment 17(c)(1)-10). Because the payments change, the disclosed APR may be off by up to 1/4 point.
